cover.desc: Full color, cold and very still — almost a still life. The bandai counter of Kotobuki-yu at night under its one warm lamp. On the countertop, closed and squared to the edge, a plain grey card document folder with a tied cloth fastener. Behind it Nagi sits upright with her hands folded in front of her, not touching it, looking at it — happi, hair clipped up, face completely unreadable. Behind her, through the open doorway, the bath hall: empty, lit blue-green, steam drifting off flat water with nobody in it. At the bottom edge of the frame, at the base of the counter, squared neatly against the wood as they have been for fourteen months: the worn blue sandals. Three objects and one person. The palette is lamp-yellow in a small pool, and cold everywhere else. Nothing is happening in this picture and everything has already happened.

chars.name: gonda
chars.expression: >_<, tiny body huge head, tangled in about forty metres of lantern wire
chars.pose: chibi, up a stepladder, entirely wrapped

chars.name: aya
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, taking a photograph instead of helping

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: chibi, unmoved, holding the ladder

panels.bg: the shotengai on Monday afternoon, chaos lines, starburst screentone, lanterns half down, folding tables stacked
panels.action: Monday. The chapter's only chibi panel, and it is outside the building.

dialogue.text: I regret everything. Cut me down.

panels.bg: the same stretch of the shotengai at 6pm, fully drawn, no chibi: lanterns gone, tables gone, the banner gone, and two-thirds of the shutters back down for the night the way they have been since page one
panels.action: By six o'clock you cannot tell that anything happened here. Silent.

panels.bg: the interior of Kotobuki-yu at 7:20pm on an ordinary Tuesday — four pairs of shoes in the rack, the fish clock, the massage chair humming, the bath hall empty beyond the doorway
panels.action: Four customers. That is a normal Tuesday and always has been. Silent.

panels.bg: the open ledger on the counter, still on the same spread: one figure in her handwriting on the festival line, and the estimate sheet still clipped to the facing page with its masking-tape flag
panels.action: Neither number has moved. Silent.

panels.bg: the empty bath hall at 8pm: the chipped Fuji mural, flat water, one lamp, steam going straight up because there is nothing in the room to disturb it
panels.action: The building spends most of its life like this. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, working the calculator

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, the fish clock at 8:14, and the noren lifting at the edge of frame

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: tired, courteous, mid-fifties, entirely ordinary
chars.pose: in the genkan taking his shoes off, a soft grey card folder under one arm

panels.bg: the genkan, sandal rack, warm lamp
panels.action: He takes his shoes off properly and turns them to face the door before he steps up. Somebody raised him well.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: apologetic about the hour and nothing else
chars.pose: a small bow at the counter, folder held in both hands

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, pen down

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp
panels.action: He does not lead with the offer. He leads with an apology about the time, which is correct.

dialogue.text: Shirakawa-san. District office.
I'm sorry about the hour. May I sit?

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: settling on the tatami bench, knees together, folder on his lap

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: coming round from behind the counter

panels.bg: the rest area, tatami bench, the fish clock, the massage chair switched off for the conversation
panels.action: There is nobody in this scene to be angry at. That is the entire problem with it.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: plain, unhurried, not softening anything

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: listening
chars.pose: seated opposite, hands in her lap

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, tatami
panels.action: He gives her the facts in the order she would want them.

dialogue.text: The plan was confirmed on the fourteenth.
The association agreed terms last week.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: matter-of-fact, treating her exactly as he would treat any owner
chars.pose: sliding a sheet across the tatami toward her

panels.bg: rest area, tatami, warm lamp
panels.action: He does not mention her age once. He never will. That is worse than if he had.

dialogue.text: The same offer goes to every frontage on the street.
There's a relocation allowance as well.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: quiet, and meaning it
chars.pose: hands on his knees, not pushing the folder any closer

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely level

panels.bg: rest area, tatami bench, warm lamp, the empty bath hall visible through the doorway
panels.action: Nine words. There is no pressure anywhere in this room.

dialogue.text: You don't have to decide tonight.

panels.bg: the top sheet from the folder, lying on the tatami. ART NOTE: layout only, no legible characters. A clean typeset acquisition summary with a ruled terms table, and beneath it a small horizontal schedule diagram — a bar with four marked stages and a date under each. Immaculate. Proofread. Not one thing wrong with it anywhere.
panels.action: The schedule has four stages. She reads it the way she reads a gauge.

dialogue.text: Vacant possession: 31 May.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes stopping on one line of the terms table and staying there
chars.pose: the sheet held flat, both hands

panels.bg: the sheet, warm lamp, tatami, flat screentone
panels.action: The figure in the fourth row is a great deal of money. The panel does not show it and she does not react to it. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: setting the sheet back down, squaring it to the folder

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: waiting without expecting anything

panels.bg: rest area, tatami, warm lamp
panels.action: It is a fair offer. It is a good offer. There is nothing wrong with it and nobody to blame for it. Silent.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: getting up, folder retied, and then hesitating over something entirely unrelated
chars.pose: half-risen, glancing toward the bath doorway

panels.bg: rest area, the steam coming through from the bath hall, warm lamp, fish clock at 8:41
panels.action: He has done eleven of these this month and he is very tired and there is hot water forty feet away.

dialogue.text: ...Is the bath still open?

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level, standing, the counter voice arriving from somewhere automatic

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp
panels.action: She answers it the way she answers it sixty times a night.

dialogue.text: Until eleven.
Then I'll have one. Thank you.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: not visible — shoulders and the back of a head only, eyes shut, entirely at rest
chars.pose: shoulders-up in the water at the far end of the bath

panels.bg: the bath hall, heavy steam across the lower two-thirds, the chipped Fuji mural, one lamp. Shoulders-up framing only, nothing else visible.
panels.action: A tired man in his fifties, in the water, forty minutes after offering to buy the building out from under a seventeen-year-old. Nobody in this chapter is a villain. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: reading, entirely still
chars.pose: at the counter with the folder open, one sheet at a time

panels.bg: the bandai counter under its lamp; beyond it the empty changing room, the fish clock, and faint water sounds from the bath hall
panels.action: She reads the whole thing while he is in the water. It takes about eleven minutes and it is all perfectly clear. Silent.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: pink from the heat, hair damp, coat over his arm, entirely restored
chars.pose: at the genkan getting his shoes on

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: behind the counter

panels.bg: genkan, warm lamp, cold night beyond the glass
panels.action: He pays four hundred and ninety yen and puts the coins in the tray.

chars.name: officer
chars.expression: half-turned at the noren, saying it because it is true

panels.bg: noren, night street beyond, warm light behind him
panels.action: Four words, from the man with the folder, and he means every one of them.

dialogue.text: It's a good bath.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: coming in, shaking the cold off, ordinary

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: at the counter, unreadable

panels.bg: genkan and counter, warm lamp, 9:40pm — and squared on the counter under the lamp, a grey card folder tied shut
panels.action: Thursday. He notices it in about two seconds, because he notices everything on that counter now.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyes going to the folder and then away, no expression put on at all

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, the folder in the foreground out of focus
panels.action: He does not ask. He does not go near it. He learned in a bottom drawer in chapter seven what he does with other people's paper. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: sleeves going up
chars.pose: walking through to the bath hall, picking the blue brush off its hook on the way

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up

panels.bg: changing room into the bath doorway, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: She does not mention it either. He goes and does the floor. Silent.

panels.bg: his phone face-up on the tile beside a bucket, screen lit, a wall of messages
panels.action: Gonda has been thinking about this since Saturday.

dialogue.text: I made a spreadsheet.
Every month = boiler paid off by August.
I already asked the noodle place. They're in.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: reading it, and it is genuinely funny, and his face cannot do funny with it
chars.pose: crouched on the wet tile, wrist resting on his knee

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, phone glow
panels.action: The spreadsheet is correct. It solves the boiler. Gonda has never heard of a hatched map. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: thumb moving, then stopping, then deleting
chars.pose: typing, holding backspace, putting the phone face-down on the tile

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, the phone going dark
panels.action: He types a reply. He deletes it. He puts the phone face-down and picks the brush back up. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: working, head down

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: working, head down

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, tile grid, one lamp — compose to echo Ch.3 page 5
panels.action: He could organise something. He is extremely good at organising something. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mouth opening

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: He has a plan. It would take about four sentences. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mouth closing, brush moving again

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: The hardest thing he does in this chapter is the same thing he did at four in the morning: nothing, at the correct distance. Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: getting up out of the chair the way seventy-eight-year-olds get up out of chairs
chars.pose: one hand on the arm, milk bottle in the other

panels.bg: rest area, the massage chair, warm lamp, fish clock at 10:52
panels.action: An entirely ordinary Thursday for exactly one person in the building.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: conversational, bent over her shoe
chars.pose: sitting on the step at the genkan, working a foot into it

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: wiping the counter

panels.bg: genkan and counter, warm lamp, cold night beyond the glass
panels.action: Small talk, at the door, at eleven at night.

dialogue.text: Cold tonight.
Mm.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: not looking up, still with the shoe, remembering something the way you remember a bus route

panels.bg: the genkan step, warm lamp, the sandal rack
panels.action: She is not telling her anything. She thinks this is a thing the family knows.

dialogue.text: He had a buyer once, you know.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: cloth stopping on the counter

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: squinting at the middle distance, doing dates in her head, mildly interested at most
chars.pose: one shoe on, one to go

panels.bg: genkan step, warm lamp
panels.action: Two more fragments. Neither of them is a sentence about anybody's feelings.

dialogue.text: ...The year you came, I think it was.
Never let it go out after that.
Not one night.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: cheerful, entirely unaware, halfway through the noren
chars.pose: raising the bottle in a small goodbye

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned at the counter
chars.pose: hand still flat on the wood

panels.bg: noren, cold night beyond, warm light behind
panels.action: She has no idea. She will never know she did it.

dialogue.text: Night, Nagi-chan.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, alone at the counter
chars.pose: standing exactly where she was, both hands flat on the wood

panels.bg: the empty changing room, warm lamp, the noren still swinging, the fish clock at 10:58, and forty feet away through the doorway the faint sound of a brush on tile
panels.action: Fourteen months of keeping a dead man's building alive for him. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: eyes open, and behind them the whole thing arriving the other way round

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: He did not leave her a building to keep. He kept a building so there would always be somewhere warm for her to go. She has had the causality backwards for fourteen months. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, at the bottom of the steps
chars.pose: standing in front of the machine

panels.bg: the boiler room, bare bulb, pipes, the gauge steady in the green, the wrench on its nail beside the worn mark in the paint, the logbook on the shelf
panels.action: Fifteen New Years. Fourteen months. Not one night. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: her palm laid flat on the boiler casing, fingers spread

panels.bg: the warm painted steel of the boiler casing, bare bulb light
panels.action: It is the warmest thing in the building and it has been kept that way, deliberately, for one person, for ten years. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: the hand lifting away, leaving a fading print of condensation on the paint

panels.bg: the boiler casing, the handprint already going, bare bulb — and above, through the ceiling, a brush moving on tile
panels.action: She takes her hand off it. The decision is made in this panel and nobody says one word about it, tonight or ever. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: working, head down, having no idea what has just happened nine feet below him
chars.pose: crouched on the wet tile with the blue brush

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: coming through the doorway behind him

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, tile grid, one lamp
panels.action: He does not look up and he does not ask. He has been getting better at this for twelve chapters. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: picking up the small brush, crouching, entirely ordinary
chars.pose: settling in beside her own patch of grout

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, the two buckets
panels.action: She does the floor with him. It takes forty minutes. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — small

panels.bg: the whole bath hall from the far end, vast tile, heavy steam, one lamp, two small figures in less than a quarter of the frame — compose to echo Ch.3 page 5
panels.action: One of these two people knows. Silent.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: at the counter with an empty crate, first thing Friday

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: level

panels.bg: the bandai counter, Friday morning, cold clear light through the glass, the grey folder still squared on the wood
panels.action: She says it the way she says bring the small brush.

dialogue.text: Ban-san.
The thirty-first. Tell them.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: hands going still on the crate, and sixty-eight years of face doing absolutely nothing with it

panels.bg: the counter, morning light, flat screentone
panels.action: He understands the whole thing immediately. He has known this street since he was four. Silent.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: picking the crate back up, going

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already back at the ledger

panels.bg: counter and noren, cold morning light
panels.action: One syllable, and by tonight every shop on the street will know.

dialogue.text: Mm.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hands only
chars.pose: both hands closing round a pair of worn blue sandals at the base of the counter and lifting them

panels.bg: the floorboards at the counter base, warm lamp
panels.action: Fourteen months squared up against that wood, wiped once a week, swept around every single night. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopped in the bath doorway with a bucket, having seen it, understanding all of it

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, standing at the counter holding them

panels.bg: the changing room from the bath doorway, warm lamp, the whole floor between them
panels.action: He does not go to her, he does not say anything, and he does not stop her. He turns round and goes back to the floor. Silent.

panels.bg: the bare floorboards at the base of the bandai counter under the warm lamp. The boards are worn honey-dark from fourteen years of feet — except for two pale sandal-shaped rectangles of unfaded wood where nothing has moved and nothing has been walked on. A broom stands propped against the counter beside them. No people, no dialogue, no sound effect.
panels.action: Final panel. Nobody in this chapter says selling, or closing, or over.
